# Third-party parts (unmodified)

| Folder | Source | Commit | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `handumi_gripper_tips/` | [murobotics-ai/handumi-hw](https://github.com/murobotics-ai/handumi-hw) `hardware/{STEP,STL}/gripper_tips` | `fc7462a` | Apache-2.0 (`handumi_gripper_tips/LICENSE`) |
| `yubi_openarm_mount/` | [Toyota/yubi-hw](https://github.com/Toyota/yubi-hw) `STEP/flange`, `STL/flange` (`OPENARM_FLANGE`, `YUBI_ATTACHMENT`) | `dd8bd13` | CERN-OHL-W v2 (`yubi_openarm_mount/LICENSE`), © 2026 Toyota Motor Corporation |

These files are redistributed unchanged. Our carriages reproduce the HandUMI tip interface
(4× M2, 8 × 12 mm) so these tips bolt on directly, and the OpenArm unit's back face takes the
`YUBI_ATTACHMENT` bolt pattern so the YUBI OpenArm flange stack is used as-is.
